title: Pixels To Performance
description: As Develop celebrates its 20th anniversary, we'll explore how game dialogue has evolved and examine the importance of cross-disciplinary influences in shaping compelling characters.
session_takeaway: Deep dive into the 20-year history of performance and dialogue in gaming.
Understand the interdisciplinary dynamics required to deliver compelling digital performances.
Tips and practices to align writers, directors, and developers around character design.
